paragraph: As of end-June 2024, the World Bank reports, [1.6 million households were registered in the Kwenda programme's management information system](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102524042530084/pdf/P169779177dc6e0f518d2610fb44ed3049d.pdf>), which runs the Kwenda cash transfer. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the system pays beneficiaries electronically. The nearest fact found is that [in 2024 the Kwenda system ran a cash transfer](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102524042530084/pdf/P169779177dc6e0f518d2610fb44ed3049d.pdf>). No source found says one information system serves several social programmes. Operating would need the programme's system to send payments to beneficiaries through banks or mobile money.

In May 2026 the World Bank said [investments in the open-source CORE-MIS and digital payments enable delivery of Merankabandi assistance nationwide](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2026/05/01/building-burundi-s-national-social-protection-systems-to-deliver-jobs-and-respond-to-crises>). [OpenIMIS states that since May 2025 the CORE-MIS solution has managed cash transfers](<https://openimis.org/blog/burundis-growing-social-protection-system-now-runs-openimis>) for 1.25 million Merankabandi beneficiaries across five provinces. It also says [multiple payment providers are integrated with the system for automated payments and reconciliation](<https://openimis.org/blog/burundis-growing-social-protection-system-now-runs-openimis>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one information system serves several social programmes. Mature would need one information system serving two or more social programmes, or contributory and non-contributory schemes together.

In 2025 Sambieni, Gnammou and Bourgeois wrote that [Benin's ARCH health insurance (AM-ARCH) uses digital solutions to manage memberships and benefits](<https://doi.org/10.3917/afco1.279.0039>). [Its beneficiaries hold an insurance card](<https://doi.org/10.3917/afco1.279.0039>). The authors say effectiveness depends on digital infrastructure, especially in rural areas. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the programme's system pays beneficiaries electronically, or that one system serves several programmes. Operating would need the programme's system to send payments to beneficiaries through banks or mobile money.

In September 2024 the IMF said [Botswana has no single fully operational electronic registry of beneficiaries](<https://www.elibrary.imf.org/view/journals/002/2024/287/article-A002-en.xml>). It said [Botswana has no joint information management system across its 30 programmes](<https://www.elibrary.imf.org/view/journals/002/2024/287/article-A002-en.xml>), so targeting and selection frequently require extensive paperwork. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a programme management information system is under way. Preparing would need a management information system for a social programme to be procured, piloted or being built.

In May 2025 the World Bank's report on the safety-net project [counted beneficiaries from the programme's information system](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099061325143037563/pdf/P175594-249b8381-1fd4-41f5-b036-e784a28bc057.pdf>). Until November 2024 its household counts came from the cash-transfer programme's own database. Since then they come from the single social registry's system. In July 2024 an ENSEA study said [the productive social safety nets project delivered 94% of its digital payments on time](<https://news.abidjan.net/articles/732473/plus-de-400-000-menages-beneficient-de-transferts-monetaires-et-de-mesures-daccompagnement-de-letat-de-2017-a-2024-selon-une-etude-de-lensea>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one information system serves several social programmes. Mature would need one information system serving two or more social programmes, or contributory and non-contributory schemes together.

No stage is set. In 2025 a World Bank project paper said [ASNEIP is scaling up its digital government-to-person payment system](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099082625105536477/pdf/BOSIB-c1db46ff-563d-4cc3-b382-1eb9e5eb6876.pdf>). By April 2025, [9,337 beneficiaries had received digital payments](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099082625105536477/pdf/BOSIB-c1db46ff-563d-4cc3-b382-1eb9e5eb6876.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that says whether a social programme runs on an information system. Establishing would need a social programme's beneficiaries enrolled and managed in an information system in service.

No stage is set. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that says whether a social programme in DR Congo runs on an information system. Nothing has been found that says a programme's beneficiaries are enrolled and managed in one, or that payments are sent through one. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a management information system for a social programme to be procured, piloted or being built.

No stage is set. [A World Bank report of November 2025 records 91% of transfers under the Social Protection and Youth Productive Inclusion Project delivered through digital payments](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099122225174011681/pdf/P174178-d3f57ca8-c3c8-481f-b065-df5bd1e79798.pdf>). [It marks the project's 80% target achieved](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099122225174011681/pdf/P174178-d3f57ca8-c3c8-481f-b065-df5bd1e79798.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that says whether a social programme runs on an information system. Establishing would need a social programme's beneficiaries enrolled and managed in an information system in service.

In April 2025 the World Bank's mid-term aide-memoire said [all technical operations of the PFSS-RRC cash transfer project, from targeting to payment statements, are already digitalised](<https://pfss-comores.org/ressources/download/8>). It says the project's Management Information System is available, with a Beneficiary Management Platform, a Complaints Platform and an Internal Management Platform. [It reports 41,703 beneficiaries receiving payments by mobile money](<https://pfss-comores.org/ressources/download/8>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one information system serves several social programmes. Mature would need one information system serving two or more social programmes, or contributory and non-contributory schemes together.

In 2025 the government issued [Decreto-Lei n.º 3/2025, which requires offices outside the central service to register social pension applications within 24 hours](<https://boe.incv.cv/Bulletins/DownloadAct?id=73659>). [They register them in the 'aplicativo informático' used to manage the pension](<https://boe.incv.cv/Bulletins/DownloadAct?id=73659>). [Its article 47 enters approved pensioners in the database of the non-contributory pensions system, which the CNPS runs](<https://boe.incv.cv/Bulletins/DownloadAct?id=73659>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the programme's system pays beneficiaries electronically. Operating would need the programme's system to send payments to beneficiaries through banks or mobile money.

In November 2026 the Ministry of Social Solidarity said [Takaful and Karama runs on an integrated software system](<https://almessa.gomhuriaonline.com/764443/>). In July 2026 it said it had [fully redeveloped the system](<https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/8317494>). Field researchers now record data on tablets instead of paper forms. In June 2026 the ministry said [4.7 million families drew their payments](<https://www.businessmen-eg.com/en/5359/social-solidarity-launches-june-takaful-and-karama-disbursement>) at bank ATMs, Fawry outlets and on Meeza cards. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one system serves several programmes. Mature would need one information system serving two or more social programmes, or contributory and non-contributory schemes together.

In October 2025 a World Bank restructuring paper said [444 of Ethiopia's 492 woredas use the PSNP management information system for programme tracking](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102025134040722/pdf/P172479-f2834346-c6c0-4568-a19e-46544cf006e6.pdf>). [Data on 5.1 million of its 7.9 million beneficiaries had been synched in the federal management information system](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102025134040722/pdf/P172479-f2834346-c6c0-4568-a19e-46544cf006e6.pdf>). The same paper says [252 woredas use electronic payments](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102025134040722/pdf/P172479-f2834346-c6c0-4568-a19e-46544cf006e6.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one information system serves several social programmes. Mature would need one information system serving two or more social programmes, or contributory and non-contributory schemes together.

In August 2026 the Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection issued [terms of reference for a software firm to develop the Ghana Integrated Social Protection Information System (GISPIS)](<https://www.mogcsp.gov.gh/?mdocs-file=8618>). The terms list [LEAP, Labour Intensive Public Works, Productive Inclusion, the Ghana School Feeding Programme and the Capitation Grant among the ministry's existing Management Information Systems](<https://www.mogcsp.gov.gh/?mdocs-file=8618>), currently integrated peer-to-peer. The planned platform would unify them. No change has been found in the last twelve months. [In 2013 LEAP moved to electronic payments through AYA Technologies, MTN Mobile Money and GhIPSS](<http://leap.mogcsp.gov.gh/background.php>), but no source found since October 2023 says the programme's system pays beneficiaries electronically. Operating would need the programme's system to send payments to beneficiaries through banks or mobile money.

In 2023 ANIES said [its information-systems experts manage the database of beneficiaries of the programmes it has run since 2020](<https://anies.gov.gn/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Rapp_Activites_mai_sept2023_ANIES_GCA.pdf>). [Households for the Nafa cash transfers were enrolled and listed from that database](<https://anies.gov.gn/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Rapp_Activites_mai_sept2023_ANIES_GCA.pdf>). ANIES also reported that under the Nafa project it [opened electronic wallet accounts for women household heads](<https://anies.gov.gn/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Rapp_Activites_mai_sept2023_ANIES_GCA.pdf>) and pays them monthly through five contracted payment operators. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one information system serves several social programmes. Mature would need one information system serving two or more social programmes, or contributory and non-contributory schemes together.

Nothing has been found that says a programme's beneficiaries are enrolled and managed in one, or that payments are sent through one. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a management information system for a social programme to be procured, piloted or being built.

In 2025 ISSA said [INSESO has piloted a paperless project to digitise its files](<https://www.issa.int/gp/285301>). [The pilot ran on family allowance files and cut processing from two days to 20 minutes](<https://www.issa.int/gp/285301>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a social programme is run on an information system in service. None says the programme's system pays beneficiaries electronically, or that one system serves several programmes. Establishing would need a social programme's beneficiaries enrolled and managed in an information system in service.

In August 2025 a social protection ministry document said [all National Safety Net Programme cash transfers use the Enhanced Single Registry](<https://www.socialprotection.go.ke/sites/default/files/Downloads/ESMP%20Template-August%202025%20(3).pdf>). It says [the CCTP comprises the Older Persons, Orphans and Vulnerable Children, and Severe Disabilities cash transfers](<https://www.socialprotection.go.ke/sites/default/files/Downloads/ESMP%20Template-August%202025%20(3).pdf>), and that [those transfers go to bank accounts and mobile money](<https://www.socialprotection.go.ke/sites/default/files/Downloads/ESMP%20Template-August%202025%20(3).pdf>). [From the January 2025 disbursement the State Department pays all Inua Jamii beneficiaries through the eCitizen-M-Pesa platform, with Safaricom](<https://www.socialprotection.go.ke/sites/default/files/Downloads/press%20release/Press%20release%20for%20Inua%20Jamii%20rollout%20-%20JAN.%202025.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. The latest dated fact found is the August 2025 document.

Nothing has been found that says a programme's beneficiaries are enrolled and managed in one, or that payments are sent through one. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a management information system for a social programme to be procured, piloted or being built.

In June 2026 Libya's Ministry of Social Affairs said [families in the wife-and-children grant programme registered and updated their data on its electronic platforms](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=359914&lang=ar>). [Arrears are paid only to beneficiaries whose data were completed and approved](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=359914&lang=ar>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the programme's system pays beneficiaries electronically, or that one information system serves several programmes. Operating would need the programme's system to send payments to beneficiaries through banks or mobile money.

In June 2024 the EU said [Lesotho's Ministry of Gender, Youth and Social Development had begun to upgrade NISSA and MISSA](<https://www.eeas.europa.eu/delegations/lesotho/eu-and-unicef-provide-new-resources-government-enhance-child-well-being-and-social-services-lesotho_en>), its National Information System for Social Assistance and Management Information System for Social Assistance. [The upgrade comes as the ministry moves to digital payments](<https://www.eeas.europa.eu/delegations/lesotho/eu-and-unicef-provide-new-resources-government-enhance-child-well-being-and-social-services-lesotho_en>). The systems are used for the Child Grants Programme. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the programme's system pays beneficiaries electronically. Operating would need the programme's system to send payments to beneficiaries through banks or mobile money.

At the end of December 2025 [the Direct Social Aid programme supported 3.9 million households, Le Brief reports from the ANSS annual report](<https://www.lebrief.ma/soutien-social-un-an-apres-impact-de-lanss-100155241/>). The CNSS and the CNRA ran its management information systems for the interim. They are being moved as they stand to the ANSS, the national social support agency, with full switchover aimed for 2026. No earlier position has been found, so no change can be stated for the last twelve months. No source found says how the programme pays beneficiaries, or that one system serves two or more programmes. Operating would need the programme's system to send payments to beneficiaries through banks or mobile money.

In May 2026 the World Bank said [INAS has an information system and a registry of over 1.2 million households](<https://www.gtai.de/resource/blob/1999512/d5f145dad744ac85e8c8fd6d42f16a49/PRO202605201999506.pdf>), and that the system needs modernising. [In April 2025 O Económico reported an IGM evaluation](<https://www.oeconomico.com/avaliacao-expoe-fragilidades-no-subsidio-social-basico-e-recomenda-reforma-urgente-para-garantir-dignidade-dos-idosos-em-mocambique/>) that e-INAS is in use for the Programa de Subsídio Social Básico, with about 450,000 beneficiaries. [INAS has contracted payment providers centrally since 2024: M-Pesa, Emola and Mkesh](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099060625133026871/pdf/P173640-21420c54-0ced-4347-8192-6604ebd266d9.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one information system serves several social programmes. Mature would need one information system serving two or more social programmes, or contributory and non-contributory schemes together.

In June 2026, a World Bank SASPP policy note says, [the Tekavoul programme made quarterly cash transfers to nearly 138,000 households](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099229507202629093/pdf/IDU-435478dd-a19c-4ed7-ba75-1aa272bee8b2.pdf>). The note says [Tekavoul runs on its own information system](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099229507202629093/pdf/IDU-435478dd-a19c-4ed7-ba75-1aa272bee8b2.pdf>). [Its limited interoperability with the Social Registry delayed renewal of the beneficiary list](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099229507202629093/pdf/IDU-435478dd-a19c-4ed7-ba75-1aa272bee8b2.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the programme's system pays beneficiaries electronically. Operating would need the programme's system to send payments to beneficiaries through banks or mobile money.

IDinsight reported in 2024 that [the Transfer Agency registers Social Cash Transfer Programme beneficiaries](<https://www.idinsight.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Report-Malawi-SCTP-E-Payment-Study_26072024-1.pdf>), sets up an e-wallet for each and records the details in the programme's management information system. In March 2025 [the National Local Government Finance Committee confirmed 95,520 cash transfer and 195,520 public works beneficiaries on e-payments in 10 districts](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099062325114042048/txt/P169198-441cfc05-221d-412e-9c5e-a5b191e1d0bb.txt>). The World Bank's Malawi Economic Monitor of 2024 said [the Unified Beneficiary Registry is partly linked to the cash transfer and public works systems](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/e9804959-688c-45c7-aadf-0e4bf2f49aae/P17952911466830541bbed1eb3d3ade0049.pdf>), with data passing one way. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No single system serving several programmes has been found. Mature would need one information system serving two or more social programmes, or contributory and non-contributory schemes together.

No stage is set. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that says whether a social programme in Namibia runs on an information system. Nothing has been found that says a programme's beneficiaries are enrolled and managed in one, or that payments are sent through one. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a management information system for a social programme to be procured, piloted or being built.

By July 2025, a World Bank report says, about 5.9 million households had received transfers. [shock-responsive cash transfer households from the Social Registers are enrolled into the payment system](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099090325094525591/txt/P176935-a76b292b-0876-428f-bd15-82f5f0c9fba7.txt>), the report adds. In the last twelve months, in June 2026, the Imo State governor welcomed [the transition from physical cash disbursement to direct bank account payments under the federal HoPE-CT programme](<https://fmino.gov.ng/fg-disburses-n6-6-billion-to-over-278000-imo-beneficiaries-under-empowerment-programme/>). NSIPA lists [an integrated and fully digitalized management information system under the government's restructuring of NASSP-SU](<https://nsipa.gov.ng/programmes/nassco.html>). No source found since October 2023 says one information system serves several social programmes. Mature would need one information system serving two or more social programmes, or contributory and non-contributory schemes together.

Rwanda's 2024 social protection sector plan says [the Monitoring and Evaluation Information System (MEIS) serves as a beneficiary registry](<https://www.minecofin.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Minecofin/Publications/STRATEGIES/Sector_Strategic_Plans_Abridged_2024_2029/Social_Protection/Final_and_validated_SPSSP.pdf>). [The plan cites it for VUP beneficiary counts for 2023-2024](<https://www.minecofin.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Minecofin/Publications/STRATEGIES/Sector_Strategic_Plans_Abridged_2024_2029/Social_Protection/Final_and_validated_SPSSP.pdf>). It says a Disability Management Information System is in the final stages of completion, to hold details of over 500,000 persons with disability. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the programme's system pays beneficiaries electronically. Operating would need the programme's system to send payments to beneficiaries through banks or mobile money.

In November 2023 DGPSN said [the RNU MIS and the PNBSF information system are in operation](<https://spdci.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Talking-Interoperability-13-Senegal-Eng-revised.pdf>). [The two systems are interconnected and hosted by SENUM-SA](<https://spdci.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Talking-Interoperability-13-Senegal-Eng-revised.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the programme's system pays beneficiaries electronically. None says one information system serves several social programmes. Operating would need the programme's system to send payments to beneficiaries through banks or mobile money.

In 2024, Sierraloaded reports, the labour ministry and NaCSA completed [a digitized registration, verification and enrolment of 13,091 aged beneficiaries](<https://sierraloaded.sl/news/ministry-labour-cash-transfer-vulnerable-aged/>), before the cash transfer it served was paid. [Orange Mobile Money then paid each of them a one-time transfer](<https://sierraloaded.sl/news/ministry-labour-cash-transfer-vulnerable-aged/>), acting as payment service provider across 10 districts. In June 2023 the World Bank recorded that [NaCSA had set up the SP Registry for Integrated National Targeting](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099062023164040814/pdf/P1435880bb78fa01f091990677538ffcfd2.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. The 2024 enrolment served a single cash transfer, and no source since October 2023 says one information system serves several social programmes. Mature would need one information system serving two or more social programmes, or contributory and non-contributory schemes together.

In November 2023 the World Bank said [the Baxnaano management information system was in development](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099122123073523097/pdf/P17134614ca3f506019183195856ebad001.pdf>), with the national cash transfer system marked in progress. [Baxnaano's page says the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs runs the unconditional cash transfer as Baxnaano's regular window](<https://baxnaano.so/unconditional-cash-transfer/>). In 2025 the page said [all payments go by mobile money to the household's registered phone number](<https://baxnaano.so/unconditional-cash-transfer/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the Baxnaano system is in service, enrolling and managing beneficiaries. Establishing would need a social programme's beneficiaries enrolled and managed in an information system in service.

In September 2025 the World Bank said [Shabaka Meisha (SNSOP) beneficiaries were biometrically registered and enrolled into the Management Information Systems](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/feature/2025/09/18/cash-transfers-are-helping-women-create-businesses-and-regain-hope-in-south-sudan>), and two transfer rounds reached 87,867 households in 15 counties. [The ministry says Shabaka Meisha cash transfers began on 17 December 2024 after beneficiaries were biometrically registered into the Government-led Management Information System](<https://mafs.gov.ss/cash-transfer/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the programme's system pays beneficiaries electronically. Operating would need the programme's system to send payments to beneficiaries through banks or mobile money.

In September 2025 a World Bank project paper said [the government now owns and operates Ké-Non directly, for the first time](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099091725161547918/txt/BOSIB-92986af7-9307-44ac-b3b9-5f75cb4949c8.txt>). [OpenIMIS says the government adopted Ke-Non, built on CORE-MIS and openIMIS, to manage the national social protection system](<https://openimis.org/blog/em-powered-openimis-island-nation-sao-tome-and-principe-effectively-managing-its-social>). The paper says [the financing continues an electronic cash-transfer payment system for beneficiaries](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099091725161547918/txt/BOSIB-92986af7-9307-44ac-b3b9-5f75cb4949c8.txt>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one information system serves several social programmes. Mature would need one information system serving two or more social programmes, or contributory and non-contributory schemes together.

In January 2026 the Deputy Prime Minister's Office said [elderly and disability grant applications are verified and processed on systems](<https://eswatinipositivenews.online/dpmo-moves-to-resolve-technical-issues-affecting-social-grants/>) that the Royal Science and Technology Park helps manage. [Technical faults in those systems were delaying applicants being added to the beneficiaries list](<https://eswatinipositivenews.online/dpmo-moves-to-resolve-technical-issues-affecting-social-grants/>). No earlier position has been found, so no change can be stated for the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the programme's system pays beneficiaries electronically. Operating would need the programme's system to send payments to beneficiaries through banks or mobile money.

In September 2026 Seychelles Nation reported that, under the REPAIR agreement, [the Agency for Social Protection will use its existing beneficiary registry](<https://nation.sc/articles/32242/seychelles-signs-cash-transfer-pact-to-boost-climate-preparedness>). [The agency will also use its existing payment systems to deliver rapid household cash transfers after disasters](<https://nation.sc/articles/32242/seychelles-signs-cash-transfer-pact-to-boost-climate-preparedness>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the programme's system pays beneficiaries electronically. Operating would need the programme's system to send payments to beneficiaries through banks or mobile money.

In September 2025 a World Bank infographic listed [a 'nouveau système de gestion des beneficiaires intégrant le MGP' for Chad](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099735205212519675/pdf/IDU-f63a01b3-734b-45cc-bdf8-323adb04c51d.pdf>). [That is a new beneficiary management system incorporating the complaints mechanism](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099735205212519675/pdf/IDU-f63a01b3-734b-45cc-bdf8-323adb04c51d.pdf>). [It is part of strengthening Chad's adaptive social protection system under the PFSAP 2025-2030](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099735205212519675/pdf/IDU-f63a01b3-734b-45cc-bdf8-323adb04c51d.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a programme is run on one in service. In April 2024 the World Bank said [the AMEN programme's management information system has been strengthened](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/programs/teri/brief/enhancing-the-social-protection-system-to-better-serve-vulnerable-populations>), which sped up beneficiary applications and eligibility verification. It said [44.4% of AMEN cash transfers are digitalised](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/programs/teri/brief/enhancing-the-social-protection-system-to-better-serve-vulnerable-populations>). [The system is being enhanced further, including interoperability with other agencies' databases](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/programs/teri/brief/enhancing-the-social-protection-system-to-better-serve-vulnerable-populations>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one information system serves several social programmes. Mature would need one information system serving two or more social programmes, or contributory and non-contributory schemes together.

TASAF's PSSN III Payment Handbook of March 2026 says [payment lists, approvals and receipts are generated in the TASAF Management Information System](<https://www.tasaf.go.tz/uploads/documents/sw-1776692069-PAYMENT%20PROCESS%20HANDBOOK.pdf>), drawn from households enrolled in the TASAF Registry. [The handbook says PSSN III benefits are paid every two months through banks and mobile money operators](<https://www.tasaf.go.tz/uploads/documents/sw-1776692069-PAYMENT%20PROCESS%20HANDBOOK.pdf>). The TASAF system routes payment instructions via the Government electronic Payment Gateway. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one information system serves several social programmes. Mature would need one information system serving two or more social programmes, or contributory and non-contributory schemes together.

On 4 February 2021 the Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development commissioned [the digital National Single Registry, Development Pathways says](<https://www.developmentpathways.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/Ugandas-National-Single-Registry_v3-compressed.pdf>). [The MGLSD feasibility report says numerous Ugandan social protection programmes operate their own management information systems](<https://socialprotection.go.ug/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Feasibility-Report-for-Ugandas-Social-Registry.pdf>), including those for the Senior Citizens Grant, the Youth Livelihood Programme and SAGE. It says [the systems of various programmes are linked to the National Single Registry](<https://socialprotection.go.ug/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Feasibility-Report-for-Ugandas-Social-Registry.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the programme's system pays beneficiaries electronically. Operating would need the programme's system to send payments to beneficiaries through banks or mobile money.

In November 2025 SASSA told Parliament's social development committee that [its Social Relief of Distress system handles about 17.8 million applications](<https://pmg.org.za/committee-meeting/42085/>). It approves about 8 million a month and checks them against Home Affairs, SARS and other records in real time. SASSA also said it runs banking checks to stop fraudulent grant payments. [In August 2024 the Department of Social Development signed agreements with other departments to build a National Integrated Social Protection Information System](<https://dsdnews.org/ijs-modernising-social-development-for-better-accountability/>). No source found says it is in service. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Mature would need one information system serving two or more social programmes, or contributory and non-contributory schemes together.

In November 2025 a World Bank project paper said [procurement of a GBV management information system was ongoing under GEWEL 2](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099111025101519517/pdf/P181391-34653b79-f98e-4c0c-a842-18e4bab01cb6.pdf>). [The system is to be integrated with the GBV call centre](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099111025101519517/pdf/P181391-34653b79-f98e-4c0c-a842-18e4bab01cb6.pdf>). In the last twelve months, in July 2026, the ministry's Permanent Secretary said [92 percent of Social Cash Transfer households were paid through mobile money or bank accounts](<https://www.zambiamonitor.com/govt-claims-k1-4-billion-released-as-social-cash-transfers-to-vulnerable-zambians-in-june/>). No source found since October 2023 says a programme enrols and manages beneficiaries in an information system in service. Establishing would need a social programme's beneficiaries enrolled and managed in an information system in service.

The World Bank's February 2026 document says [the social protection information system, now called ZISO, is still being made operational](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099030926024025866/txt/P514401-e5a07636-f85a-4936-8383-b57dbd46cf7c.txt>). It needs household enumeration and hosting first. In August 2023 the social welfare ministry, with the World Bank and UNICEF, [launched the Integrated Social Protection Management Information System](<https://healthtimes.co.zw/2023/08/18/zimbabwe-launches-social-protection-management-system/>), piloted in Cyclone Idai districts. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source names the system that runs the cash transfer. No source since October 2023 shows a programme's beneficiaries managed in a working system. Establishing would need a social programme's beneficiaries enrolled and managed in an information system in service.
